What changed
column4: Practical impact

column2: Tables 2‑1.1 to 2‑3.19 (SI) and their C (U.S. Customary) companions
column3: All rating tables revised (records 21‑1888, 22‑564, 23‑2509)
column4: Allowable pressures were re-issued, not just re-typeset. Read 2025 values before reusing a 2020 or 2017 rating on a drawing or datasheet.

column2: Nonmandatory Appendix A — Tables A‑1 and A‑2 (rating ceiling pressures)
column3: Ceiling pressures revised (record 22‑2110); tables also revised under 21‑1888
column4: The ceilings the p/T tables are built on changed. This is the mechanism behind the Foreword's statement that ratings were revised after adopting new ceiling values.

column3: Added for Material Group 2.13, duplex materials (records 21‑1888, 23‑2509)
column4: Duplex stainless flanges now have a dedicated rating table. Check the grade against Group 2.13 rather than an adjacent group.

column3: At 1 000 °F, working pressure for Classes 400–2500 revised; Note (2) added (records 21‑1888, 23‑2509)
column4: The 1 000 °F entries in those U.S. Customary tables moved. Hot-service designs that sit close to a limit need re-checking.

column2: C rating tables generally — temperature columns and notes
column3: First temperature entry under 'Temp., °F' revised in many C tables; metric temperatures in notes rounded to the nearest degree; notes revised and reordered (records 21‑1888, 22‑564, 23‑2509)
column4: Do not assume the first row or the notes of a C table are identical to the 2020 printing.
The master material list changed. Confirm the ASTM specification named on the purchase order is still listed for the intended material group.

column3: Specifications for Groups 3.1 (35Ni‑35Fe‑20Cr‑Cb) and 3.12 (46Fe‑24Ni‑21Cr‑6Mo‑Cu‑N) corrected, and a second forging/plate specification added for Group 3.6 (33Ni‑42Fe‑21Cr), all by errata (record 21‑1145)
column4: Some nickel-alloy entries were wrong or incomplete in the previous printing — re-check certificates and material test reports against the 2025 list.

column2: Tables 1.1‑1, 2‑3.7, 2‑3.8 and 2‑3.12 to 2‑3.14, with their C companions
column3: ASTM B462 and ASTM B564 forging specification materials added (record 16‑1229)
column4: Two more nickel-alloy forging specifications are recognised in the material and rating tables, widening the supply options for nickel-alloy flanges.

column3: ASTM A320 L7M added under intermediate-strength bolting; ASTM B511 (N08830), B572 (N06230) and B637 (N07740, N07718) added under nickel and special alloy (record 22‑651); notes revised, reordered and clarified (records 21‑1888, 21‑2211, 22‑651)
column4: New bolt grades are now inside the standard, including low-temperature L7M and nickel-alloy grades. Re-read the notes before pairing bolts with a flange material.

column3: Wording of 'corresponding material' clarified (record 21‑2211)
column4: Removes an ambiguity about which bolt material may be used with which flange material when the bolting is bought separately.

column2: Figures 7 and 8; Tables 8, 11, 14, 16, 18, 20 and 22 (and their C companions)
column3: Hub height H and a new Note (1) added to Figures 7 and 8; method for the minimum hub height revised (record 22‑2183)
column4: Hub geometry was re-ruled, not just redrawn. Read hub and length-through-hub values from the 2025 edition rather than a 2020 drawing.

column3: The 'B' dimension (the bore shown in the flange figures) revised for slip-on, socket-welding, welding-neck and lapped flanges (record 21‑579)
column4: The inside diameter is a dimensioned value, not a note. Compare the 2025 table with any 2020 or 2017 bore dimension before accepting a part.

column3: Class 150 threaded figure now shows threads continuing to the flange face; Class 300 threaded figures now include a counterbore (record 23‑628)
column4: Threaded-flange geometry changed — relevant when machining, gauging or inspecting threaded flanges.

column2: Table 7 (Class 150 drilling templates) and Table 8 / 8C (Class 150 flanges)
column3: NPS 20 outside diameter O corrected from 693 to 698; NPS 14 outside diameter O corrected from 553 to 533 (records 21‑1134, 21‑1133)
column4: Two outside diameters printed in the 2020 edition were wrong. The 2025 figures (698 mm and 533 mm) are the ones to use.

column3: Class 2500 NPS 2½ groove depth E corrected from 9.522 to 9.53; a dimensionless row under NPS 24 in Table 5C deleted and alignment corrected (records 21‑1372, 22‑1148)
column4: Groove depth affects ring-joint gasket seating — verify the groove against the 2025 table.

column3: General Note (b) revised in Figures 1 and 2 (record 22‑567); U.S. Customary values added to Figure 12 (record 21‑1122)
column4: Clarifications rather than new requirements, but worth a fresh look if drawings or specifications quote those figures.

column3: Definitions of may, shall and should added; 'must' changed to 'shall' and related sentences revised to match (record 22‑2279)
column4: The clauses were reworded to match the new definitions rather than to change a value. Contract or specification wording that quotes the clause may differ.

column3: Guidance added; the last sentence of Clause 5.3.4 deleted (record 21‑1888)
column4: Part of the same change record that added the General Notes in the rating and material tables and Nonmandatory Appendix G — read them together.

column3: Requirements for system hydrostatic testing revised (record 21‑1849)
column4: Check hydrostatic test pressures and procedures in inspection and test plans against the new wording.

column2: Nonmandatory Appendix G — Low Temperature Applications (new)
column3: Added for determining minimum temperature limits for materials (record 21‑1888)
column4: A new nonmandatory method for determining minimum design temperature, with a table of example minimum use temperatures. The appendix is not reproduced here; read it in the current edition.

column3: References updated (record 23‑2265)
column4: The reference standards cited by B16.5 moved on; update any reference list in a specification or QA system that tracks them.

column2: Titles of complementary SI / U.S. Customary table pairs; Clause 7.3
column3: Titles revised to state the applicable system of units (Summary of Changes introduction, printed p. xiv); Clause 7.3 editorially revised
column4: Easier to tell SI from U.S. Customary tables. No technical effect.
